Orders usually take 1–2 weekdays to process at our warehouse before shipping out via 2-day shipping. Total delivery typically takes up to 4 business days, though orders placed late in the week ship out the following Monday or Tuesday.
Tracking details are sent automatically by email as soon as your package ships. If it's been 3–4 days since you ordered, be sure to check your spam folder, or let me know your order number and email address so I can check on it for you!
